title: Report: GPT-6 Exposed with 10 Trillion Parameters, Forced Release in August; OpenAI May Have a Bigger Weapon by Year-End, Doug

content_html:
AI insider reporter ChrisGPT revealed that despite government censorship, GPT-6 (previously temporarily paused Astra model) will be released in August. It is estimated that GPT-4 has about 1.8 trillion parameters, and if Astra reaches 10 trillion parameters, it would be more than five times larger than GPT-4. OpenAI has made an unprecedented scale in pre-training. Just nine months ago, OpenAI realized that Anthropic was leading in pre-training and urgently reallocated computing resources. Now the time has finally come.

However, GPT-6 in August may just be a starter. ChrisGPT also disclosed an upcoming "epic monster" called Doug, which is said to be the largest pre-trained model in OpenAI's history, making the flagship Fable seem like a primitive product. Doug is not GPT-6. According to insiders, it is likely to use the next-generation Vera Rubin chips from NVIDIA, which have not been fully rolled out yet. Due to the need for pre-training and extensive cybersecurity testing, it is expected to be released by November at the latest. OpenAI's strategy is clear: GPT-6 will attract users in August, and then Doug will be released at the end of the year to regain absolute leadership.

The wall of pre-training has finally been broken, and the rivalry between two major players is established

Doug is crucial because it points to a reality the industry has been reluctant to face: since the release of GPT-4o in May 2024, OpenAI has not completed full-scale pre-training for its next-generation cutting-edge model for over two years. o1, o3, GPT-5, and GPT-5.5 are essentially post-training and reinforcement learning based on the GPT-4o foundation. The "engine" of GPT has not been replaced for two years. Projects like Orion were downgraded due to unsatisfactory performance, until the release of Gemini 3 last year prompted the boss to decide to replace the engine. The verification experiment called Garlic was completed first, and Doug is the true product after scaling up. This means that OpenAI may have overcome the performance degradation and stability bottlenecks of ten thousand card clusters, proving that Scaling Laws still hold in the pre-training dimension.

At the same time, the competitive landscape has changed dramatically. On August 5th, Google's chief scientist Jeff Dean left with three core researchers to start his own business. Hassabis stepped down as CEO of DeepMind and moved to chairman. Alphabet's stock dropped over 4% that day. The place where the Transformer was invented is now supplying top talent to competitors. The "three giants" of Silicon Valley ASI now only have OpenAI and Anthropic left.

Anthropic holds Fable 5 and is preparing to release Fable 5.1 in August, keeping the price unchanged and directly targeting Astra. It seems to be using a "Tian Ji's horse racing" strategy, saving the strength of Opus 5 and launching Fable 5.1 as an ambush. OpenAI is holding both GPT-6 and Doug. The old engine has been squeezed to the limit over the past two years. When the engine is truly upgraded, how fast this system can run will be answered by Doug at the end of the year.

content_html_zh:
AI 内幕记者 ChrisGPT 透露，尽管有政府审查，GPT-6（此前暂时暂停的 Astra 型号）仍将于 8 月发布。 据估计，GPT-4大约有1.8万亿个参数，如果Astra达到10万亿个参数，将比GPT-4大五倍多。 OpenAI 在预训练方面取得了前所未有的规模。 就在九个月前，OpenAI 意识到 Anthropic 在预训练方面处于领先地位，并紧急重新分配计算资源。 现在终于到了。

然而，8 月份的 GPT-6 可能只是一个开始。 ChrisGPT 还披露了即将推出的名为 Doug 的“史诗怪物”，据说这是 OpenAI 历史上最大的预训练模型，使得旗舰产品《Fable》看起来像是一个原始产品。 道格不是 GPT-6。 据内部人士透露，它很可能会使用NVIDIA的下一代Vera Rubin芯片，该芯片尚未完全推出。 由于需要进行预培训和广泛的网络安全测试，预计最迟将于 11 月发布。 OpenAI 的策略很明确：GPT-6 将在 8 月份吸引用户，然后年底发布 Doug，重新夺回绝对领先地位。

赛前训练的围墙终于被打破，两大选手的较量正式确立

Doug 之所以至关重要，是因为它指出了业界一直不愿面对的一个现实：自 2024 年 5 月发布 GPT-4o 以来，OpenAI 已经两年多没有完成其下一代尖端模型的全面预训练。 o1、o3、GPT-5、GPT-5.5本质上是基于GPT-4o基础的后训练和强化学习。 GPT的“引擎”已经两年没有更换过。 像Orion这样的项目因性能不理想而被降级，直到去年Gemini 3的发布才促使老板决定更换引擎。 首先完成了名为“Garlic”的验证实验，放大后的“Doug”才是真正的产品。 这意味着OpenAI可能已经克服了万卡集群的性能下降和稳定性瓶颈，证明Scaling Laws在预训练维度仍然成立。

与此同时，竞争格局也发生了巨大变化。 8月5日，谷歌首席科学家杰夫·迪恩带着三名核心研究人员离开，开始自己创业。 哈萨比斯辞去 DeepMind 首席执行官职务，转任董事长。 Alphabet 的股价当天下跌超过 4%。 变形金刚的发明地现在正在为竞争对手提供顶尖人才。 硅谷ASI的“三巨头”现在只剩下OpenAI和Anthropic了。

Anthropic持有《神鬼寓言5》，准备在8月份发布《神鬼寓言5.1》，保持价格不变，直接瞄准Astra。 似乎是在使用“田忌赛马”的策略，保存Opus 5的实力，推出神鬼寓言5.1作为埋伏。 OpenAI 持有 GPT-6 和 Doug。 老旧的发动机这两年已经被挤压到极限了。 当发动机真正升级后，这套系统能跑多快，年底道格就会给出答案。
